text: Taranis Investments Overview Taranis Investments is an investment firm specializing in sustainable projects and technologies, focusing on renewable energy and carbon management. As the investment arm of the Perenco Group, Taranis operates through distinct funds, including Taranis Energy for Africa, which invests in renewable energy projects across the continent to improve access to sustainable energy. Taranis Carbon Ventures is dedicated to investing in innovative technology start-ups that accelerate the development of solutions for carbon circularity and industrial decarbonisation. Taranis Decommissioning invests in various asset classes to finance the decommissioning of Perenco's assets, while Taranis Nature-Based Solutions encompasses investments in projects that preserve natural ecosystems and enhance their carbon absorption potential. In December 2024, Taranis strengthened its Energy for Africa fund by acquiring the Africa business of Akuo, an international developer and producer of renewable energy. This strategic acquisition integrated Akuo's local portfolio of projects and expertise in developing renewable energy in Africa. In February 2025, Taranis acquired a 35% minority stake in Rougier Afrique International, a leader in responsible African wood, aiming to combine Taranis' expertise in sustainable energy and carbon management with Rougier's knowledge in responsible forest management. Taranis' investment philosophy focuses on reconciling economic performance with environmental responsibility, aiming to generate tangible social impact. By leveraging Perenco's industrial expertise, Taranis seeks to drive sustainable development across various sectors, including renewable energy, carbon management, and nature-based solutions, contributing to a more sustainable and inclusive growth in the regions it serves. Frequently asked questions about Taranis Investments What sectors does Taranis Investments invest in? Taranis Investments invests in Technology, Energy, Real Estate, Renewable Energy, Circular Economy and Carbon Capture, and is based in England, United Kingdom. Taranis Investments is listed as a private investment firm in the ConnectSafely investor database. What stage does Taranis Investments invest at? Taranis Investments backs companies at Growth, Late Stage, Pre-IPO, Buyout, Turnaround and Distressed, writing cheques of 1M - 50M. Which regions does Taranis Investments invest in? Taranis Investments invests across United States, United Kingdom, Brazil, France, Mexico and Egypt. What companies has Taranis Investments invested in? Taranis Investments's portfolio includes Novoloop, Circ, Cool Planet Technologies, Akuo Africa, Rougier Afrique International, Econic Technologies and Pryme.
